name: h3-spatial-toolkit
description: Standardized H3 SDK, spatial analysis tools, REST API, CLI, PostGIS adapter and web demo.

scripts.check:static: pnpm check:contract && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:repository && pnpm check:shell && pnpm check:release-metadata && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint
scripts.benchmark: pnpm --filter @h3-toolkit/core build && pnpm --filter @h3-toolkit/geometry build && tsx benchmark/index.ts --write
scripts.benchmark:diagnostic: pnpm --filter @h3-toolkit/core build && pnpm --filter @h3-toolkit/geometry build && tsx benchmark/index.ts --write --diagnostic
scripts.benchmark:record: pnpm --filter @h3-toolkit/core build && pnpm --filter @h3-toolkit/geometry build && tsx benchmark/index.ts --write --diagnostic
scripts.acceptance:local: pnpm check:static && pnpm check:golden && pnpm check:supply-chain && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:contracts && pnpm check:licenses && pnpm audit --prod
scripts.acceptance:api: pnpm build && node scripts/api-cli-smoke.mjs && node scripts/production-deploy-smoke.mjs
scripts.acceptance:full: pnpm acceptance:local && pnpm acceptance:api && pnpm acceptance:browser && pnpm benchmark && pnpm acceptance:database
scripts.acceptance: pnpm acceptance:local && pnpm acceptance:api && pnpm acceptance:browser && pnpm benchmark && pnpm check:release-metadata
